easyPrerequisites: Warden of the Grove has a counter on it.
description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Warden of the Grove triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat
